name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After serving in the Austrian Federal Army, specializing in security and risk assessment, she sought a career change that combined her expertise with her lifelong passion for racing. Her meticulous nature and commitment to detail quickly caught the eye of a regional racing team. 

As Security Chief, Klara believes in a proactive, preventative approach. She prioritizes threat analysis and comprehensive security protocols to ensure the safety of personnel and assets. While relatively new to motorsport management, her dedication to learning the intricacies of the industry and her ambition to establish a robust security framework distinguish her. She is driven to implement innovative security solutions that will safeguard her team and the racing environment.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and pulled back into a tight bun
physical.description: Klara is a tall, athletic woman with a piercing gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and potential security vulnerabilities.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning her glasses, even when they appear spotless.
Insists on conducting security briefings in precisely 15-minute intervals.
